market_question: Will Jamie Dimon win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Jamie Dimon has not declared any candidacy, will be 72 in 2028, and has no electoral experience. The base rate for a non-politician CEO securing a major-party nomination and winning the presidency is far below 1%, making the market's ~0.9% price an overestimate.
evidence_points: Dimon has consistently denied presidential ambitions and has no campaign infrastructure.
At 72 years old in 2028, he would be one of the oldest first-term presidents.
No non-politician CEO has won the presidency without prior elected office in modern history (Trump had celebrity and political branding; Dimon lacks that).
sources_consulted: Public statements by Jamie Dimon regarding political aspirations
Historical data on CEOs running for president
Current political landscape and 2028 election field
